dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual 2D geometric narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Largely symmetrical margins with minor irregular edge definition at the water-skin interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium slate-grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency dark-grey patches distributed across the mid-to-posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions observed between the primary grey baseline and localized mottled patches.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of faint, longitudinal, light-colored linear marks on the mid-dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Fine, superficial linear striations scattered across the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast, circular dark aperture positioned at the anterior-most visible portion of the dorsal plane.
